# Arkenstone Defense

Arkenstone Defense is a Software Development company. Arkenstone provides federal business back office infrastructure to access and run federal contracts for modern technology companies supporting national security. Arkenstone Defense employs 80 people. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, United States.

## About

Arkenstone exists to remove execution friction between modern technology companies and the U.S. national security ecosystem.

Arkenstone is a dual-layered federal business back office infrastructure for compliance, HR, and contracting.

Foundation is the federal contracting eligibility layer - closing compliance gaps, getting you audit-ready, and keeping you qualified to win and maintain contracts.

Cohort is the operating and scaling layer - handling workforce, payroll, and labor compliance so you can execute without risking performance or margin.

Learn how Arkenstone can accelerate your mission with our back office infrastructure.
